C0401.title: Microsoft Discloses Tycoon2FA AiTM Phishing Kit Operating at Scale
C0401.summary: On March 4, Microsoft disclosed that Tycoon2FA had rapidly become a widespread phishing-as-a-service platform after emerging in August 2023, and that it was developed, supported, and advertised by the threat actor Microsoft tracks as Storm-1747. The platform provided adversary-in-the-middle capabilities, mimicked sign-in pages for Microsoft 365, OneDrive, Outlook, SharePoint, Gmail, and other services, and helped lower-skilled attackers bypass MFA and compromise accounts. Related campaigns reached more than 500,000 organizations worldwide each month and generated tens of millions of phishing messages.

references.title: Inside Tycoon2FA: How a leading AiTM phishing kit operated at scale
